rows.evidence: The circular floor drain / manhole M3 (manhole_m3_rim, manhole_m3_shaft, manhole_m3_opening) is completely hidden or covered by the basement_floor mesh, leaving only the vertical gauge rod sticking out of a flat grey floor.; The rebar rod (basement_rebar_rod) on the floor to the left of the drain and the sensor cables (sensor_cable_1, sensor_cable_2) are also submerged beneath or occluded by the basement_floor.; Camera 5 framing needs a tiny shift so the wooden door handle on the far left is visible and the back-wall vent aligns with the real image.; In the render, the camera is slightly too close to the scene (or the FOV is slightly too narrow), making the wooden door on the left, the central pillar, and the manhole appear slightly larger and shifted to the right compared to the real frame.; In the real frame, the manhole is slightly further left (closer to the center) and slightly higher in the frame, and more of the floor in front of the manhole is visible.; The green base inside the manhole opening should be dark/concrete colored rather than green in the dry scene.; The cam5 simulation view already aligns well with the real camera frame in terms of camera perspective, central pillar, wooden door, sandbag, rebar rod, and floor drain position.; Slightly panning the camera left (decreasing lookAt x slightly) centers the pillar and drain marginally better.
